API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APICloud App Control PolicyWeb Application Rule Resource Get Rule By ID
Web Application Rule Resource Get Rule By ID
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/webApplicationRules/:rule_type/:ruleId

Gets a Cloud App Control policy rule by the rule type and ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
rule_type
string
REQUIRED

Possible values: [SOCIAL_NETWORKING, STREAMING_MEDIA, WEBMAIL, INSTANT_MESSAGING, BUSINESS_PRODUCTIVITY, ENTERPRISE_COLLABORATION, SALES_AND_MARKETING, SYSTEM_AND_DEVELOPMENT, CONSUMER, HOSTING_PROVIDER, IT_SERVICES, FILE_SHARE, DNS_OVER_HTTPS, HUMAN_RESOURCES, LEGAL, HEALTH_CARE, FINANCE, CUSTOM_CAPP, AI_ML]

The rule type selected from the available options.

ruleId
int32
REQUIRED

The ID of the Cloud App Control policy rule.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

Web Application Rule Id

type
string

Possible values: [ANY, NONE, SOCIAL_NETWORKING, STREAMING_MEDIA, WEBMAIL, INSTANT_MESSAGING, BUSINESS_PRODUCTIVITY, ENTERPRISE_COLLABORATION, SALES_AND_MARKETING, SYSTEM_AND_DEVELOPMENT, CONSUMER, HOSTING_PROVIDER, IT_SERVICES, FILE_SHARE, DNS_OVER_HTTPS, HUMAN_RESOURCES, LEGAL, HEALTH_CARE, FINANCE, CUSTOM_CAPP, AI_ML]

order
int32

Order of execution of rule with respect to other Web Application rules

timeQuota
int32

Daily limit value for time up to which uploading and/or downloading of data is allowed from the Web Application Rule

sizeQuota
int32

Daily limit value for size up to which uploading and/or downloading of data is allowed from the Web Application Rule

string

Additional information about this rule

object[]

object[]

object[]

state
string

Rule State

Possible values: [DISABLED, ENABLED]

timeWindows
object[]
rank
int32

Admin rank of the admin who creates this rule

validityStartTime
int32

If enforceTimeValidity is set to true, the Web Application rule ceases to be valid on this start date and time.

validityEndTime
int32

If enforceTimeValidity is set to true, the Web Application rule ceases to be valid on this end date and time.

validityTimeZoneId
string

Validity time zone id for start and end time if rule has time based expiry

lastModifiedTime
int32
lastModifiedBy
object
enforceTimeValidity
boolean

Enforce a set a validity time period for the Web Application rule

userAgentTypes
string[]

User Agent types on which this rule will be applied

Possible values: [OPERA, FIREFOX, MSIE, MSEDGE, CHROME, SAFARI, OTHER, MSCHREDGE]

devices
object[]
deviceGroups
object[]
deviceTrustLevels
string[]

List of device trust levels for which the rule must be applied. While the High Trust, Medium Trust, or Low Trust evaluation is applicable only to Zscaler Client Connector traffic, Unknown evaluation applies to all traffic. The trust levels are assigned to the devices based on your in the Zscaler Client Connector Portal. If no value is set, this field is ignored during the policy evaluation.

Possible values: [ANY, UNKNOWN_DEVICETRUSTLEVEL, LOW_TRUST, MEDIUM_TRUST, HIGH_TRUST]

tenancyProfileIds
object[]
accessControl
string

Access privilege of this rule based on the admin's RBA state.

Possible values: [NONE, READ_ONLY, READ_WRITE]

cloudAppRiskProfile
object
name
string

Rule Name

labels
object[]
cbiProfile
object
userRiskScoreLevels
string[]

List of user risk score levels for which policy must be applied. If not set, the policy will be applied for all user risk score levels.

Possible values: [ANY, LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL]

object[]

boolean
